description: April 30 birthday meaning: Taurus decan 1, birthday number 3, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, an April 30 birthday falls in Taurus, in the first decan, with Venus as the sign's ruler and Venus as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 3. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Taurus is fixed and earth.

sections.heading: Personality of an April 30 birthday
paragraphs: April closes with the Sun about nine degrees into Taurus, near the end of the Venus decan. Thirty reduces to 3, the number of expression and joy. The tradition describes a warm, creative and sociable person, at ease with pleasure, who often expresses affection through music, cooking, craft or simply good company.

By noon UTC on April 30, the Sun has normally reached roughly 9° of Taurus. That places the date in the Taurus decan that astrologers give to Venus, the first of three. With Venus as both ruler and sub-ruler, the first decan of Taurus is traditionally seen as the sign at its most sensuous and steady. Birthdays from about April 20 to April 30 land here. The emphasis is on comfort that has been earned: texture, taste, music and the slow pleasure of things done well. This doubled Venus tone is often linked with loyalty and a calm, grounding presence that friends lean on. It can also make change feel like an imposition rather than an invitation. Those born in this decan tend to flourish when they treat flexibility as another form of care, not a threat to it.

sections.heading: Numerology of the April 30 birthday
paragraphs: A birthday on the 30th reduces as 3 + 0 = 3. The 0 is often read as amplifying the 3, so this birthday number carries an extra dose of expression, imagination and social energy. Unlike the 12th or 21st, the compound contains only the 3 itself, which numerologists sometimes describe as creativity without dilution. Thirtieth-born people are frequently described as eloquent, entertaining and quick with ideas. As a secondary number, the 30 tends to shine in writing, speaking or performance. Focus is their usual challenge, since so many ideas compete for attention.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same April 30 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 7 for 1980, 8 for 1990, 9 for 2000 and 1 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: April 30 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: April birthdays arrive in full northern spring, with lengthening days and fast growth; in the southern hemisphere the month belongs to mid-autumn and harvest. Aries carries most of April, handing over to Taurus around April 19 or 20. As month 4, April brings numerology's number of structure, steadiness and hard work, a grounding counterweight to the quick fire of the month's early birthdays. April 30 is the 120th day of the year (121st in a leap year). In most years Gemini season is under way by May 21, 21 days after this birthday.

Chinese astrology is straightforward for an April 30 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies. April 30 is also the birthday of Carl Friedrich Gauss (1777), António Guterres (1949) and Stephen Harper (1959).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is April 30?
faq.answer: April 30 is Taurus in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Taurus, which tradition links with Venus.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on April 30?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On April 30 the Life Path is 5 in 1960, 6 in 1970, 7 in 1980, 8 in 1990, 9 in 2000, 1 in 2010 and 11 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 3 for everyone born on the 30th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on April 30?
faq.answer: By April 30 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on April 30?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with an April 30 birthday are Carl Friedrich Gauss (1777), António Guterres (1949) and Stephen Harper (1959). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
